_comment: Attach-only, deliberately. There is no separate front-end dev server to start: the
Worker serves web/dist itself, so the app and the API share an origin and the session
cookie works. Run the Worker yourself with
and these entries point the preview pane at it. An earlier entry here tried to launch
`npm run dev --prefix web` on 5173, which starts a Vite server nothing serves the API
from — and fails outright in sessions where launching dev servers is not permitted.
